scope: Read-only requirement and exact evidence provenance audit; new browser checks executed only for the identified native/image eventing Admin gap. No completed platform suite rerun, appsource change or external publication.

criteria.criterion: Pinned Kafka/KRaft images and client compatibility; dependencies, volumes, private listeners, secrets, resources, readiness/startup/shutdown; distinct durable installation cluster IDs and legacy metadata preservation.
limits: Kubernetes test CNI does not enforce NetworkPolicy. Production requires an enforcing CNI.
Private single-broker plaintext Kafka lane; authenticated REST overlay does not qualify broker SASL_SSL or ACLs.

criteria.criterion: Owned Compose and Kubernetes model-free applications with optional existing/GPU/remote model; explicit manifest/chart ownership.
limits: Existing pinned model container was reused unchanged; optional GPU profiles additionally rendered/schema-validated but no second GPU service or model pod was started. Existing or remote endpoint alternative was exercised through actual accepted images.

criteria.criterion: Single-node versus replicated durability; single-writer hub; backups/restore; broker upgrades and hot hub propagation.
limits: Patch upgrade only8.3.1 to8.3.2; no cross-minor/application downgrade or HA guarantee.

criteria.criterion: Clean Compose and disposable Kubernetes with real Kafka and no model; actual A2A pub/sub and backend literal search.
Replacement/restart; PVC/volume reuse; broker outage/actual version upgrade; secret rotation; optional model enablement; manifest/image/dependency/license inventories.
limits: Optional native AuthenticationHandler requires Enterprise entitlement or permitted trial. Production entitlement is not attested.

criteria.criterion: Document full-server and project-level backup/restore semantics, collision handling and container recovery.
criteria.covered: Actual consistent full-server recovery across all project stores/config/Kafka, preserved credentials/membership/IDs/acks and exact recovery boundary.
criteria.open: Selective project restore preserving other current projects is not implemented or qualified. Roadmap requires project-level semantics while normatively imposing conditions on any project restore. Parent has requested user scope clarification; do not silently narrow requirement or claim full-server restoration proves selective recovery.

criteria.criterion: Container replacement and backup/restore without leakage or duplicate committed results.
limits: Lifecycle/worker-crash/fairness evidence belongs to other exact-artifact suites; selective project restore remains separate open scope.

criteria.criterion: Deployment, model, backup/recovery and troubleshooting operating contracts updated alongside packaging.
Zero-model raw/literal-search and separate actual live-model filtering/semantic queries on accepted deployment images.
limits: Six actual provider POSTs per platform, counted across classification, semantic query and resumed subscription; no broad model calibration or latency claim.

criteria.criterion: Exact artifact/image/broker/client identities; independent container/Kubernetes recovery and Admin operating suites with remaining limits.
limits: Other KAFKA009 federation, wire, fault, migration, fairness and overall lifecycle closure require parent-owned reports; this audit does not substitute platform checks for those gates.

configuration_inventory.hot_hub_settings: All supported hub settings via Admin, including local/OIDC userauth, matcher/backend model bindings, KafkaURL/bearer/customCA/topic/retention/queue policy, shared resources and store location. Configuration-file location alone requires restart.
configuration_inventory.infrastructure_settings: Broker/listener/staticquorum/image/volumes, model container/GPU and proxy keystores/OAuth server material belong to deployment tooling and may roll those services without restarting hub.
configuration_inventory.installation_id: Ten independent bootstrap cases plus exact-byte Kubernetes mirror and actual nonroot PVC runtime; initialtutorial metadata adopted, mismatch rejected beforeformat.

read_only_validation.kubernetes_baseline_and_optional_model: kubectl apply --dry-run=client succeeded for deploy/k8s and deploy/k8s/model.yaml; no resource writes.

recommendation.KAFKA-007: All implementation and evidence checkboxes may close with documented single-broker, CNI, license and patch-version limits.

recommendation.KAFKA-009-deployment: Deployment clauses covered; global program closure remains parent-owned and includes unresolved project-restore scope.
